parameterisation.offsets_applied_to: compiled model, positive sign, five upstream joints by name
parameterisation.residual: Euclidean distance at each of the five joint origins, stacked over poses
parameterisation.poses: numpy default_rng(0), 100 samples, uniform -1.7 to 1.7 rad, all six joints
parameterisation.translation: mean(official origins) - mean(ours origins), added to ours in world

superseded: median 168 mm at the same joint vector: correct as measured, but it compares two models whose zero poses and base frames differ, so it is not a robot error
median 38 mm after a tip-centroid fit: the tip is dominated by the jaw frame, which disagrees by 5.74 mm at rest; five-anchor fitting is the right residual

the 27.6 to 94.5 mm line-distance family: five of six joint minimum distances are attained more than 250 mm along the axis, so that metric is degenerate and the bounded anchor-to-axis numbers 94.2 to 110.3 mm are the ones to quote
